class: A merge that auto-resolves most files can still leave conflict markers in one of them; an audit that only LISTS the files changed on both sides for a human to read lets the markers be committed and pushed, because nobody reads a list while other checks are green.
mechanism: 2026-10-15: the W-066 merge of main (commit 15f3182) resolved backend/ofo/table/model.py by hand and committed `<<<<<<< HEAD / ======= / >>>>>>> origin/main` in docs/process/coverage-stages.yaml; scripts/orchestrator/merge_audit.py printed the file under 'changed on both sides (read these)' and exited 0; the markers were found by eye in a later diff.

first_seen.evidence: git diff origin/main origin/build/W-066-on-main showed the three marker lines at yaml lines 151/154/158; the new merge_audit run on `. f184333 64b10e7 15f3182` exits 1 naming exactly those lines.

fix: The audit scans every file the merge changed at the merged head and fails on a marker line (a bare ======= only with a <<<<<<< in the same file).
